fair-haired = having light-coloured hair
curly hair = hair that forms curls, not straight
freckles = small brown spots on the skin, often on the face
beard = hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks
slim = thin in an attractive, healthy way
overweight = heavier than is healthy or expected
middle-aged = neither young nor old, often about 40–60
teenager = a person aged about 13 to 19
twins = two children born to the same mother at the same time
outgoing = friendly and enjoying other people's company
shy = nervous about talking to people you do not know well
honest = always telling the truth and not cheating
reliable = someone you can trust to do what they promise
stubborn = not willing to change your mind
generous = happy to give time or money to others
jealous = unhappy because someone has something you want
embarrassed = feeling silly or uncomfortable in front of others
proud of = pleased with what you or someone else has done
get on with = to have a friendly relationship with someone
look like = to have a similar appearance to someone
take after = to be similar to an older relative in looks or character
fashionable = popular at the moment in clothes or style
casual clothes = comfortable clothes for everyday life, not formal
tracksuit = a loose jacket and trousers for sport
hoodie = a sweatshirt with a hood
trainers = comfortable shoes for sport or everyday wear
jewellery = objects such as rings, necklaces or earrings
make-up = substances put on the face to change how it looks
good-looking = attractive in appearance
bad-tempered = becoming angry easily
easy-going = calm and not easily upset
self-confident = sure of your own abilities
sensitive = easily hurt by what other people say
cheerful = happy and showing it
get dressed = to put your clothes on
grow up = to change from a child into an adult
blonde = having yellow or very light hair
dark-haired = having brown or black hair
straight hair = hair that does not curl
wavy hair = hair with soft waves, not tight curls
bald = with little or no hair on the head
moustache = hair that grows above a man's mouth
wrinkles = lines on the skin that come with age
scar = a mark left on the skin after a cut heals
dimple = a small hollow in the cheek that shows when you smile
tall = of more than average height
short = of less than average height
medium height = neither very tall nor very short
well-built = with a strong, wide body
skinny = very thin, often in an unhealthy way
plump = a little fat, in a soft way
pretty = attractive, usually of a girl or woman
handsome = attractive, usually of a man or boy
ugly = unpleasant to look at
pale = with light skin, or looking ill
tanned = with darker skin after time in the sun
broad-shouldered = with wide shoulders
elderly = old, used politely about people
young = having lived for only a short time
adult = a person who is fully grown
childhood = the time when you are a child
personality = the type of character a person has
kind = friendly and wanting to help
mean = unkind; not wanting to share or spend
funny = making people laugh
serious = not joking; thinking carefully
lazy = not wanting to work or make an effort
hard-working = putting a lot of effort into work or study
clever = quick to learn and understand
silly = not sensible; a bit stupid
brave = ready to do something dangerous or difficult
cowardly = too afraid to do what is right or needed
patient = able to wait without getting angry
impatient = easily annoyed by waiting
selfish = caring only about yourself, not others
helpful = ready to give help
bossy = always telling other people what to do
ambitious = wanting to be successful
confident = sure of your own abilities
nervous = worried and a little afraid
calm = not excited or angry
moody = changing quickly from happy to angry or sad
optimistic = believing that good things will happen
pessimistic = believing that bad things will happen
creative = good at thinking of new ideas
organised = planning things well and keeping them in order
messy = untidy; not in order
loyal = staying a friend and not leaving someone in trouble
bored = feeling that nothing is interesting
excited = very happy and full of energy about something
surprised = feeling that something unexpected has happened
angry = feeling strong dislike because of something unfair
sad = unhappy
happy = feeling pleasure and contentment
afraid = feeling fear
proud = pleased with yourself or someone else
ashamed = feeling bad because you did something wrong
sweater = a warm knitted piece of clothing for the top half of the body
cardigan = a sweater that opens at the front with buttons
blouse = a shirt for women or girls
skirt = a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and is not trousers
dress = a piece of clothing for a woman or girl that covers the body in one piece
jeans = trousers made of strong blue cotton
leggings = tight trousers made of stretchy material
shorts = trousers that end above the knee
socks = soft coverings for the feet, worn inside shoes
boots = shoes that cover the ankle or more
sandals = open shoes for warm weather
slippers = soft shoes you wear only indoors
coat = a piece of clothing you wear over other clothes outdoors
jacket = a short coat
scarf = a long piece of cloth worn around the neck
gloves = coverings for the hands with separate fingers
hat = something you wear on your head
cap = a soft hat with a stiff peak at the front
belt = a strip of leather or cloth worn around the waist
pockets = small bags sewn into clothes for carrying things
striped = with a pattern of lines
spotted = with a pattern of round marks
plain = without a pattern
tight = fitting very close to the body
loose = not tight; with extra space
wear = to have clothes on your body
get changed = to take off one set of clothes and put on another
